name: Ghost
tagline: A 3D-printed Destiny Ghost that listens, talks back and opens like the in-game scan.
facts: Designed as 12 STL files; estimated ~500 g of filament and ~32 hours of printing
Designed at 180 mm tip to tip closed, 200 mm open
Shell modelled straight from the Bungie reference sheet: the same 8 pieces
Designed so each shell piece rides a spring-loaded pin and one servo pulls them shut through a Bowden cable
Planned hardware: Raspberry Pi 4, a round 1.28 inch LCD eye, I2S mic and amp, 16-LED ring, three servos
Software written: offline wake word and speech-to-text on the Pi, Claude for the personality, emotion tags that drive the eye, lights and body
Parametric generator: every dimension is a parameter, collisions checked automatically
Fan project. Destiny and the Ghost belong to Bungie.
status: In design. The parametric generator, all 12 STLs, the renders and the software are written. Nothing has been printed or assembled yet, so every claim is about the design or the plan.
